title: How to Add a Coming Soon Page on Squarespace 2026, Enable Maintenance / Under Construction Page
description:
Here is I will show you How to Add a Coming Soon Page on Squarespace 2026, Enable Maintenance or under construction page Easily.


In today’s video, I’ll show you how to add a coming soon page on Squarespace — step by step.
Whether you’re preparing for launch, redesigning your site, or just working behind the scenes, a coming soon page keeps your visitors informed and builds excitement.

We’ll cover two easy methods: one using a landing page, and another using password protection — both ideal if you want to hide your Squarespace website during development or simulate Squarespace maintenance mode.

Let’s get started.

✅ Method 1: Use a Cover Page or Landing Page as Your Homepage
Step 1 – Create a New Page

Log in to your Squarespace account and open your dashboard.

Go to Pages, then scroll to the Not Linked section.

Click the + button and choose Blank Page or Cover Page — a great way to create a minimal landing page on Squarespace.

Name it something like Coming Soon or Under Construction.

Step 2 – Design the Page

Add a bold heading like “Launching Soon” or “We’re Building Something New”.

You can include a coming soon banner, short message, your logo, social media links, or even an email capture form in Squarespace to start building your subscriber list early.

Use page sections and style settings to match your brand.

Step 3 – Set it as the Homepage

Hover over the new Coming Soon page and click the ⚙️ Settings icon.

Scroll down and enable Set as Homepage.

Hit Save.

Now your coming soon page is live. Visitors will only see this page, while the rest of your site stays hidden in the Not Linked section.

✅ Method 2: Use Site-Wide Password Protection
This method is perfect if you want to enable Squarespace maintenance mode or block access entirely during your build.

Step 1 – Go to Site Availability

From the main dashboard, click Settings - Site Availability.

Step 2 – Enable Password Protection

Select Password Protected, enter a password, and write a short message like “Site Coming Soon” or “Check Back Soon.”

Click Save.

This will password protect your Squarespace site, and only users with the password can view it.

💡 Pro Tip: Combine this with your coming soon or email capture page, so even while your site is locked, you can still collect emails from early visitors.

And that’s it!

That’s how to add a coming soon page on Squarespace, whether you need a simple under construction page, or a secure password protected site during development.

If you found this helpful, give it a like, subscribe for more Squarespace tutorials, and drop your questions in the comments.

Thanks for watching!
